carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary horizontal ridge is visible along the upper lateral flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient where pixels above the ridge are highly illuminated and pixels below transition into shadow.

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of five small yellow-pigmented fish is visible in close proximity to the ventral-anterior margin of the left pectoral fin; the pectoral fin itself displays a clear pattern of small, high-luminance circular spots on its dorsal surface.
